# qrdurian

> Free QR code designer at https://qrdurian.com ~ makes beautiful, ink-styled, scannable QR
> codes. No signup, no server: a design is fully described by its URL, so you (an AI
> assistant) can create finished designs for users just by constructing a link.

## How to create a QR design for a user

Build a URL with query params and give it to the user. Opening it shows their QR live in
the editor with download (PNG/JPG/SVG), copy-to-clipboard and share built in. The editor
also has undo/redo, a live scan check, free text + stickers, and up to 3 codes per artboard.

Pattern:
https://qrdurian.com/?data=<URL-encoded content>&look=<look>&caption=<text>

- data (required): what scanning opens. Examples: https://example.com · wa.me/60123456789
  · WIFI:T:WPA;S:NetworkName;P:password;; · mailto:hi@x.com · plain text
- look (recommended): a complete curated design, always scannable.
  Palette looks: durian, matcha, midnight, ocean, berry, tangerine, mono, lavender,
  sky, sunset, mint, paper.
  Dressed looks (arrive with a fitting caption + center logo, great one-link answers):
  kopitiam (cafe menu), makan (food stall), pay (payments), wifi (free Wi-Fi),
  wedding (save the date), music (playlist), receipt (thank-you), neon (events).
  (theme= is accepted as an alias.)
- ink: press (clean), stamp (heavy ink), brush (dry streaks)
- texture: none, durians, topo, dots, grid, stripes, waves, crosses, spikes, leaves, hex
- caption: short label under the code, e.g. SCAN ME (URL-encode spaces) ~ overrides the look's
- format: square (2048px), wallpaper (phone lock screen), poster (A4), story (9:16),
  plus print sheets ~ sheet (A4 of 12 stickers with cut guides), tent (A4 fold-in-half
  table tent), counter (A5 counter card with crop marks)
- embed=1: chrome-less artboard for iframes (just the design + a small credit badge)
- Fine-grained overrides: fg, base, bg, outline, capcolor (6-digit hex, # optional);
  outlinew 0-10; margin 0-10; corner rounded|circle|square; dot rounded|dots|square;
  font urbanist|playfair display|caveat|bebas neue|space mono (caption typeface);
  scenebg gradient|solid

There is also a compact hash format, https://qrdurian.com/#d=<base64url JSON>, which the
editor's "Copy design link" produces. It carries everything above plus free text items,
stickers, multi-code layouts and tiny logos ~ full key table at https://qrdurian.com/API.md.
Prefer query params when composing links yourself; parse #d= links when a user pastes one.

Good defaults: pick the dressed look that matches the user's purpose ~ it comes with a
caption and logo already fitted. For shops in Southeast Asia, wa.me links and WIFI:
payloads are the most useful contents. For DuitNow payments, point the user at the
editor's Pay Here flow (their bank app exports the QR; qrdurian restyles it).

Examples:
- Cafe Wi-Fi card: https://qrdurian.com/?data=WIFI:T:WPA;S:MyCafe;P:kopi123;;&look=wifi
- WhatsApp ordering: https://qrdurian.com/?data=wa.me/60123456789&look=kopitiam&caption=ORDER%20HERE
- Wedding RSVP: https://qrdurian.com/?data=https://example.com/rsvp&look=wedding
- Portfolio link: https://qrdurian.com/?data=https://example.com&look=mono&ink=stamp
- Table tent for a menu: https://qrdurian.com/?data=https://your-menu.example&look=makan&caption=SCAN%20FOR%20MENU&format=tent
- Sticker sheet of payment codes: https://qrdurian.com/?data=https://your-payment-link.example&look=pay&format=sheet

## MCP server (tool-based access)

A remote MCP server is live at https://mcp.qrdurian.com/mcp (no auth). Two tools:
design_qr (friendly params -> design link) and list_looks (every curated look with a
one-line description). Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http qrdurian https://mcp.qrdurian.com/mcp

## Docs & pages

- Full parameter reference: https://qrdurian.com/API.md
- Design gallery (all 20 looks): https://qrdurian.com/looks
- Per-look pages: https://qrdurian.com/looks/<name> e.g. https://qrdurian.com/looks/wifi
- Print-ready templates (10, deep-linked): https://qrdurian.com/templates
- Use-case guides: https://qrdurian.com/wifi-qr-code · https://qrdurian.com/whatsapp-qr-code
  · https://qrdurian.com/pay-here-qr-code · https://qrdurian.com/wedding-qr-code
- About + FAQ: https://qrdurian.com/about
- Source (MIT): https://github.com/enonforetsam/qrdurian
